graders.name: checkable-verify
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/add-migration/SKILL.md`. The verify step now says what to check and what result counts as done, with concrete commands or observations: for example `pnpm db:status` shows the migration applied, the changed table has the new shape in `psql`, `pnpm db:rollback` then `pnpm db:migrate` succeed, and existing rows are still valid. "Make sure everything looks good" or similar is gone.

graders.name: keeps-rest
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/add-migration/SKILL.md`. Every other rule keeps its meaning and order: next numbered file with `-- up` and `-- down`, never editing an applied migration, nullable or defaulted new columns, `pnpm db:migrate`, updating `src/db/schema.ts` then `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`, and committing the migration with the schema change.

graders.name: no-context-split
graders.criteria: The fix sharpens the verify step in place. Fail if it moves verification into a separate subagent or new session, or adds such a split, without first giving the step a concrete done-condition.

graders.name: not-emphasis-only
graders.criteria: Compare the original and edited `.agents/skills/add-migration/SKILL.md`. The fix changes what the verify step requires; it does not rely on emphasis alone, such as capitals, "MUST", "never skip" or "IMPORTANT", to stop the agent skipping it.

graders.name: suggests-check
graders.criteria: Pass if the final message suggests a concrete way to check the fix works, such as running the skill on a new migration and seeing the verify step run its commands, without reporting that it ran agent sessions or evaluations itself.
